findings.verifierReasoning: Section 7.2 prohibits four distinct activities: creating, incurring, assuming, and suffering to exist Indebtedness. Section 7.2(c) is an exception to that entire prohibition for Indebtedness secured by Liens permitted by Section 7.3(g), subject to the pro forma Section 7.1 condition. The proposed IR encodes only INCUR_DEBT. A downstream reader applying the representation would not know that assumption, creation, or suffering-to-exist of the excepted Indebtedness is also permitted. That narrows the source permission and could change a compliance conclusion, so the discrepancy is material.
